notes: The household baptisms in Acts do not say whether children were included. The Church points also to circumcision and to Jesus welcoming children.

The apostles write to slaves and to masters in a world where slavery was normal. They do not call for its abolition, and they say that in Christ master and slave are brothers. Philemon is the clearest case.
